No prompt injection, data exfiltration, network access, or hidden command execution intent was found.

content.value_statement: Complex product teams need clear architecture choices before implementation starts. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compare stacks, plan workflows, and document decisions.
actual_capabilities: Lists architecture considerations for frontend, backend, mobile, database, DevOps, and cloud stacks.
Documents reference topics for patterns, system design workflows, and technology decisions.
Includes three Python command line scripts with target validation and basic report output.
Can emit JSON output from each script to stdout or a user selected file.
Gives concise checklists for quality, performance, security, and maintainability reviews.
limitations: The included scripts are scaffolds and do not perform deep dependency or architecture analysis.
Reference documents contain generic placeholders rather than detailed production patterns.
Commands in the documentation require user approval and a trusted local project.
It does not replace human architecture review, threat modeling, or cost analysis.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Architecture
use_cases.description: Define core services, data stores, integrations, and tradeoffs before a team starts implementation.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Project Direction
use_cases.description: Check architecture assumptions, quality practices, and missing decision records during a technical review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Architecture Discussions
use_cases.description: Give teams a repeatable structure for comparing stacks, documenting risks, and recording decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Map My System
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this product idea and propose a simple architecture. Include main components, data stores, external services, and two risks. Context: [describe product].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Stack Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these technology options for my project. Explain fit, tradeoffs, team impact, and operational risk. Options: [list options]. Constraints: [list constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Review Architecture Risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed architecture for scalability, security, maintainability, and cost risk. Provide prioritized findings and practical next steps. Architecture: [describe design].

prompt_templates.title: Create Decision Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an architecture decision package for this initiative. Include context, decision drivers, options, recommendation, rejected alternatives, risks, mitigations, and rollout plan. Initiative: [describe].

output_examples.input: Plan a customer dashboard for a SaaS product.
output: Recommended architecture: Next.js frontend, Node.js API, PostgreSQL database, and background jobs.
Tradeoffs: faster delivery with managed services, with vendor dependency risk.
Next steps: confirm scale targets, auth requirements, and reporting latency.

output_examples.input: Compare GraphQL and REST for a mobile app backend.
output: Decision frame: REST is simpler for stable resources; GraphQL helps varied mobile views.
Risks: GraphQL requires stronger query limits and monitoring.
Recommendation: choose REST unless clients need flexible nested reads.

best_practices: Share goals, constraints, traffic expectations, data sensitivity, and team skills before asking for a design.
Use the scripts only on trusted local projects and review any file output path before running them.
Record final decisions as architecture decision records with owners and review dates.
anti_patterns: Asking for a full architecture without product goals, scale targets, or compliance constraints.
Running deployment or install commands from examples without checking the project and environment.
Treating generic reference templates as final production guidance.

faq.question: Does this skill create real architecture diagrams?
faq.answer: It includes a script scaffold for diagram reports, but it does not generate visual diagram files by itself.

faq.question: Can it inspect my existing codebase?
faq.answer: The scripts validate a target path and produce basic reports. They do not perform deep code analysis.

faq.question: Is it safe to run the included scripts?
faq.answer: Run them only on trusted projects. Review output paths because the scripts can write report files.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it choose a tech stack for me?
faq.answer: It can compare options and tradeoffs. A project owner should make the final decision.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy infrastructure?
faq.answer: No. The documentation lists deployment commands as examples, but users must review and approve any execution.
